leads.reason: Posts of Nov 14 are mostly call-group profit claims with contract addresses and pairing shills (FIFI, Woodstock, Belle). One post claims a Snoopy social-media/seasonal trend, but it also promotes the coin and is unsupported; the pump.fun coin is about 44 days old.
The e1 search for $GTA$ returned zero posts (call refunded), so no story can be confirmed or ruled out; re-check next window.
Many fresh GTI copycat pools (0.2h old) with only project self-promo and call posts; GTA VI hype exists but nothing ties these coins to it. Recheck later.
A Jensen Huang leather jacket meme may exist, but the search was refunded as off-target, the JACKET pool on four.meme is months old, and most JENSLA posts are call-group shills.

Posts are the coin's own account (billtobillion) posting promo one-liners, a pump.fun referral shill and copy-reply spam; the Billions Network $BILL posts are an unrelated token. No event or origin story.
Posts for $OTHER are promotion by an unrelated payments-app account, call-group and risk-alert posts, and a Nov 10 post about an older Other Cat; the fresh pools are copycat tickers with no story.

All 2026-11-14 posts are call-group shills (entry alerts, 'Nx from my call', DM for TG) repeating one contract address; the only story-like post is a Sept 10 Hood Avatars Robinhood item, which predates these pools and is a different project.
Only call-group and contract-address posts claiming 2x-6x on the new Horse Inu coin, plus older unrelated $HI posts (Holy Inu in October, HyperFlow, hi.com); no story behind the ticker.
